caption: The video captures a tranquil lake on a bright day, held in a nearly fixed viewpoint. A dense line of green trees borders the far shore, with a small house partly hidden among them on the left, and a blue sky streaked with thin, wispy white clouds fills the upper half. Tall green reeds crowd the right foreground, leaning over the water's edge. The calm surface mirrors the tree line and the clouds almost symmetrically across the middle of the scene. Throughout, the reflected image on the water wavers and subtly morphs, the mirrored clouds and tree shapes gently distorting as the surface shifts. The sky, tree line, distant house, and foreground reeds themselves stay essentially fixed, so the visible change is concentrated in the shimmering reflection. This gentle distortion is already underway and continues without clear onset or completion.
relations: The still water mirrors the fixed tree line and cloud-streaked sky as a near-symmetric reflection.
Continuous micro-ripples on the surface make the reflected clouds and trees waver and morph.
Real trees, house, reeds, and sky stay essentially stationary while only their reflection deforms.
The gentle reflection distortion persists throughout without a clear onset or completion.
